video_prompt: One continuous vertical phone selfie video, full frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The man — an East Asian man about 38 years old with short straight black hair neatly combed to the side, clean-shaven, thin black rectangular glasses, wearing a plain olive-green henley shirt — sits alone in a modern apartment kitchen with dark cabinets behind him, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera, his head in the lower half of the frame. The phone rests steady; the camera stays still; the room around him stays still. He talks straight into the camera, serious and confident, like telling a friend a secret, with small natural head movements and calm shoulders.
